authority: Stage-3 layer A, the GEPA arm (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-24-slurp-stage3-gepa-arm-design.md; owner decisions 83 and 101): the SOURCE population of the GEPA delta store. A GEPA contact is rendered from its GROUP's rows -- their rollout trajectories and their construction gold -- so the rows an authored GEPA delta may cite are the union of the groups' row_sample_ids. core.semantic_knowledge_preparation verifies a release registration's permitted_roster as a committed roster_role='construction' receipt AND requires its split identity to equal the registration's source_split_identity_hash, so this population needs a committed receipt of its own. The FLOWN population is the different, also committed SLURP-STAGE3-GEPA-R01C-CARRIERS-V1 (one contact per carrier row). The precedent is SLURP-STAGE3-ADVANTAGE-R01C-DISAGREEING-V1, where the flown population and the store source are the same rows; the GEPA arm separates them because a group shows more rows than its carrier.

d1_supplement.note: the R01 D1 media supplement is NOT rebuilt for R01C. It closes over all 800 parent recordings, a strict SUPERSET of R01C's 625, and contracts.gate_media_identity._d1_media_supplement_records verifies the supplement's own integrity and then looks each FLOWN id up in it -- it never requires an exact cover. The R01C runtime view therefore carries the parent's supplement triple verbatim.

draw_method: No draw. This receipt is a pure SELECTION of the parent receipt's frozen items: every surviving item is the parent's item verbatim, in the parent's order (ascending sample_id). The seed is the parent's and is carried for provenance only -- no rng is consulted anywhere in this build, and no score, quality or label is read.

knowledge_source_guard.asserted: set(R01C sample ids) & set(composite source_sample_ids) == set(); the exact intersection rails.runner.run_speech_native_agent_loop computes before it dispatches a single row
knowledge_source_guard.derivation: core.config.compose of the ROLL-1 cell's four fragments, then rails.knowledge_stores.load_knowledge_store_binding; the guard set is the composite snapshot's source_sample_ids (the union over composed stores, rails.knowledge_stores._composite). The dataset fragment cannot move this set: only knowledge_stores feeds it.

roster_role_note: construction: these rows' own construction gold and rollout trajectories were rendered into the GEPA contact, which produced an artifact (a delta proposal) and never an answer to an evaluated row (owner decision 82). This roster is the SOURCE population of the GEPA delta store -- the rows an authored delta may cite -- not the flown population, which is the carriers receipt.
selection_rule: R01C restricted to the UNION of the prepared GEPA groups artifact's row_sample_ids -- every row any group showed its contact. A carrier topped up from the roster, from which no proposal was rendered, is not in this roster unless some group also showed it; order preserved.
